title: What to sell in 2027: the product categories growing fastest in Europe
lede: At CoCreate Europe in London, Alibaba.com shared which categories European buyers ordered most this year. Creative toys and gifts grew 231%, motorcycles and scooters 141%. Here is what that means for your next product and how to test an idea in 24 hours.
dateLabel: Published 24 November 2026 - based on data shared at CoCreate Europe, 19 November
intro: On 19 November 2026, at the CoCreate summit in London attended by more than 5,000 European business owners, Alibaba.com said its European orders and buyers have each grown 70% over three years.

The breakdown by category is the useful part. It shows where European small businesses are already putting money, and where suppliers, samples and data are easy to find. Below are the four growing categories, product ideas for each and what to check before you order.

catsIntro: Pick a category to see product ideas, what to check and a ready prompt for your AI agent.

cats.name: Creative toys and gifts
ideas: Plush toys based on niche hobbies
cats.check: Toys sold in the EU need the CE mark and EN 71 safety testing. Ask for test reports before you order samples, and check small-part and age labelling.
cats.prompt: Find 5 verified suppliers of [creative toy or gift idea] that already have EN 71 and CE test reports. MOQ under 300 units, unit price under [price] EUR. Compare price, MOQ, lead time, customisation options and certificates in a table, and calculate my margin if I sell at [price] EUR in [country].

cats.name: Motorcycles and scooters
cats.check: E-scooters and their batteries face strict EU rules (CE, EN 17128 for light electric vehicles, battery transport rules). Accessories and parts are often an easier way into the category.
cats.prompt: I want to sell [scooter or motorcycle accessory] in [country]. Find 5 verified suppliers, show certifications relevant to EU sales, MOQ, unit price, lead time and shipping restrictions for batteries if any. Rank them by risk and calculate landed cost and margin at a selling price of [price] EUR.

cats.name: Auto parts
cats.check: Fitment data is everything: list exact car models and part numbers. Lighting and safety parts may need E-mark approval for road use.
cats.prompt: Find 5 verified suppliers of [auto part] compatible with [car models]. For each, show part numbers, E-mark or other certifications, MOQ, unit price and lead time. Flag any supplier without clear fitment data and calculate my margin at [price] EUR.

cats.name: Electronic components
cats.check: Consumer electronics need CE and RoHS, and you are responsible for WEEE and battery take-back in many EU countries. Verify that certificates match the exact model.
cats.prompt: Find 5 verified suppliers of [electronic product] with valid CE and RoHS certificates for the exact model. Compare price, MOQ, lead time, warranty and reorder rate in a table, list what I need for WEEE compliance in [country] and calculate my margin at [price] EUR.

faq.q: What products will sell well in 2027?
faq.a: Alibaba.com data for European buyers shows the fastest growth in creative toys and gifts (+231%), motorcycles and scooters (+141%), and double-digit growth in auto parts and electronic components.

faq.q: Where does this data come from?
faq.a: From Alibaba.com's CoCreate summit in London on 19 November 2026, as reported by TMTPost, Ebrun and others. It reflects GMV from European buyers on Alibaba.com.

faq.q: Which category is easiest for a beginner?
faq.a: Gifts and accessories usually have lower MOQs and simpler logistics than e-scooters or electronics. Still check CE and safety requirements for your market.

faq.q: Can I really validate a product in 24 hours?
faq.a: You can complete the research and decision part in a day with AI agents: demand, suppliers, verification and margin. Samples and certification take longer.
